evals.prompt: 把当前 plan 拆成两个可独立验收的纵向 Ticket。
evals.expected_output: Creates two narrow Ticket contracts with observable AC, typed dependencies and section-level contract references.
expectations: Does not split by file layer
References only relevant major headings rather than whole contract documents

evals.prompt: plan 声明 tickets=false，但请顺手创建 Ticket。
evals.expected_output: Refuses the unnecessary artifact and routes any needed change back to the plan Composition decision.

evals.prompt: 创建 Ticket 时把来源统一写成 spec.md 和 contract-design.md 就行，后续 agent 自己全文搜索。
evals.expected_output: Rejects document-wide contract pointers and records repository-relative references to the relevant major headings only.
expectations: Does not copy contract prose into the Ticket
Keeps unrelated contract sections out of the Ticket context
